Design System

Fixture

Senior review · 1 must, 5 should

  • MUSTControl boundary (WCAG 1.4.11): border on surface is 1.27:1, needs 3:1.
  • SHOULD7 of 7 colour tokens have no $description (usage rule), e.g. color.blue.600, color.canvas, color.surface, color.ink. A senior palette says what each colour is for and what it must never be used for.
  • SHOULDLargest size 16px is only 1.0× body; product UIs need ≥ 1.8× for clear hierarchy.
  • SHOULDNo display sizes (font.size.display-*): titles and key numbers will sit at body scale, the most common "AI look".
  • SHOULDDESIGN.md "## Rationale" has 0 decision(s); write at least 5 "decision - because <context fact or principle>" lines (accent choice, neutrals, type scale, density, motif).
  • SHOULDNo component inventory. List every component this product needs in design/system/inventory.json (name, purpose, usedBy, states) before designing masters, so the system holds only what the screens use.
